name: @roadcast/ask-element
description: Ask, as a <bolt-ai-ask> custom element — one self-contained file that embeds the assistant in any host, React or not.
//repository: Required by GitHub Packages: it resolves the owning repository from this field and refuses a publish that does not name one. It is also what makes the package page link back to the source.
//publishConfig: Pinned to GitHub Packages so a stray `npm publish` cannot put an UNLICENSED first-party component on the public registry. `restricted` is GitHub Packages' default for an org scope and is stated rather than assumed, because the failure mode of getting it wrong is public.
//sideEffects: TRUE, and load-bearing. This package's entire purpose is a side effect: importing it calls customElements.define('bolt-ai-ask'). Hosts import it for effect and use no bindings, so a bundler told sideEffects:false would tree-shake the whole thing away and leave an inert tag with no error.
